controls.controlled_verification: Use synthetic values and observable boundaries; internal storage remains unknown without evidence.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Do not infer encryption-at-rest from HTTPS or cloud branding.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Required properties hold across the actual data lifecycle, with documented key access.

controls.source_trace: Client connection -> trust store -> certificate/hostname check -> downstream service.
controls.controlled_verification: Observe the relevant authorized endpoint or test client with a dedicated trusted fixture CA.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An edge connection says nothing about downstream verification; self-signed test trust can be deliberate.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Invalid peer identity is rejected; a correctly trusted legitimate peer still connects.

controls.source_trace: Password encoding API -> salt/work settings -> stored record -> verify/rehash.
controls.controlled_verification: Use controlled records supplied through source/test access; black-box inference stays limited.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A string prefix and tiny timing sample are not an algorithm/work-factor audit.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Current applicable guidance is documented; valid logins migrate safely and invalid passwords fail.

controls.source_trace: High-level crypto API -> key scope -> nonce lifecycle -> decrypt consumer.
controls.controlled_verification: Alter synthetic ciphertext only in an approved fixture and inspect pre-use rejection.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Random-looking output does not prove entropy or nonce uniqueness.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Nonce requirements hold and integrity failure releases no usable plaintext or side effect.

controls.source_trace: Entropy source -> generation/import -> key store/access -> consumer.
controls.controlled_verification: Inspect supplied configuration/source and provenance; never try discovered keys externally.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A code constant may be public/nonsecurity; establish key purpose and exposure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Security-relevant keys have suitable provenance and access; earlier weak material is replaced.

controls.source_trace: Format/key ID -> old/new readers -> re-encryption -> retirement/revocation.
controls.controlled_verification: Exercise synthetic old/new records and failure cases in a local migration fixture.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Updating a generator does not repair secrets produced earlier.
controls.remediation_acceptance: New writes use intended key; approved old reads work during migration; retired material loses authority.
